principles: OpenAI extracts and explains; the Opportunity Graph retrieves; MAI evaluates evidence, uncertainty, gaps, and next responsible action.
Possibilities are exploration paths, not predictions, rankings, or recommendations.
Critical missing information should trigger questions rather than invented conclusions.

evidence_status_legend.verified: The source is official or primary and was checked for this dataset build.
evidence_status_legend.partial: The source supports the broad opportunity, but user-specific eligibility or current availability still requires verification.
evidence_status_legend.needs_update: The source is official but time-sensitive, older, or likely to change before a user acts.
evidence_status_legend.missing: A needed claim has no source yet and must not be presented as established fact.

opportunities.title: Remote worker new-life pathway in Abu Dhabi

best_fit_user_signals: Works remotely for an employer or clients outside the UAE
Wants Abu Dhabi lifestyle without immediately changing employer
Can document income and remote employment
circumstances_that_help: Remote contract/employment is stable
Income documentation is available
Family, schooling, housing, tax, and healthcare questions are considered separately
circumstances_that_block_or_slow: Income below official threshold
Works for a UAE entity rather than outside-UAE entity
Cannot document employment or bank statements

transferable_capabilities.from_user_signal: Has remote job, contract, or international clients
transferable_capabilities.how_it_transfers: Can support a non-employer-led relocation pathway if visa and documentation requirements are met

transferable_capabilities.from_user_signal: Can coordinate housing, schooling, healthcare, and work timezone constraints
transferable_capabilities.how_it_transfers: Can become a new-life plan that does not depend first on Abu Dhabi employment

abu_dhabi_opportunity.description: Explore the Remote Work Visa route and practical new-life planning for users who keep foreign employment while living in Abu Dhabi.

opportunities.why_this_matters_in_abu_dhabi: Some users can relocate without first finding a local job or founding a company, but only if the remote-work evidence and application route are currently viable.

evidence_refs.claim: ADRO's Remote Work Visa page states eligibility includes working remotely for an entity outside the UAE and earning monthly income of no less than USD 3,500 or equivalent, while noting nomination request submission is currently unavailable through ADRO.
evidence_refs.source_name: Abu Dhabi Residents Office Remote Work Visa
evidence_refs.evidence_summary: Official source supports criteria but also flags current ADRO submission limitation, so actionability must be verified.

missing_evidence: Current application route if ADRO nomination is unavailable
Family sponsorship and dependent implications
Tax, employer compliance, health insurance, and housing requirements
gap_questions: Who is your employer or client base, and are they outside the UAE?
Can you document monthly income and bank statements?
Are you relocating alone or with dependents?
what_would_change_assessment: A currently available application route would make this more actionable.
Income below the threshold would block this specific route.
Dependents would require additional verification.
opportunities.next_responsible_action: Verify the current remote-work visa application channel and document requirements before making housing, school, or travel commitments.

demo_classification_hints.your_request_when: User asks about moving to Abu Dhabi while keeping a remote job.
demo_classification_hints.other_possibility_when: User asks about career relocation but already has stable remote income.

guardrails: Do not state that application is available through ADRO when the source says it is currently unavailable there.
Do not give tax or immigration advice.

opportunities.title: Specialist or researcher long-term residency evidence check

best_fit_user_signals: Researcher, scientist, engineer, technologist, healthcare/education specialist, executive, or highly skilled professional
Has advanced degree, publication metrics, UAE employment, professional license, or recognized expertise
Wants long-term residency stability
circumstances_that_help: Can document degree equivalency, citation metrics, professional classification, salary, license, or recommendation
Has UAE employment or relevant local authority recommendation where required
Understands category-specific criteria
circumstances_that_block_or_slow: No category match
Missing equivalency, recommendation, salary, license, or UAE employment evidence
Application channel unavailable for a subcategory

transferable_capabilities.from_user_signal: Advanced degree, publications, professional license, executive role, or specialized occupation
transferable_capabilities.how_it_transfers: Can be checked against Abu Dhabi Golden Visa specialist categories rather than treated as generic career strength

transferable_capabilities.from_user_signal: Can provide official degrees, salary certificates, contracts, licenses, publications, or recommendations
transferable_capabilities.how_it_transfers: Converts personal achievement into verifiable residency eligibility evidence

abu_dhabi_opportunity.description: Assess whether the user may fit a specialist, researcher, skilled professional, healthcare, education, or industry/4IR Golden Visa evidence pathway.

opportunities.why_this_matters_in_abu_dhabi: Long-term residency can change the user's planning horizon, but only if category-specific evidence exists; this is exactly where MAI should ask for documents instead of guessing.

evidence_refs.claim: ADRO's Specialists page lists Golden Visa specialist categories and criteria including scientists/researchers, industry and 4IR specialists, healthcare specialists, education specialists, skilled employees, and related evidence requirements.
evidence_refs.source_name: Abu Dhabi Residents Office Golden Visa for Specialists
evidence_refs.evidence_summary: Official ADRO source supports specialist category evidence checks.

evidence_refs.claim: ICP describes Golden Residency as intended to attract investors, entrepreneurs, and exceptional talent to support economic growth and strengthen the UAE skills base.
evidence_refs.source_name: Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs & Port Security
evidence_refs.evidence_summary: Official federal source supports the broader national Golden Residency context.

missing_evidence: Exact Golden Visa category and subcategory match
Current application availability and channel for the chosen category
User-specific documents: degree equivalency, salary, license, recommendation, metrics, contract, or UAE employment
gap_questions: Which evidence do you have: UAE employment contract, salary certificate, degree equivalency, professional license, publications/citations, or authority recommendation?
Are you applying from inside or outside the UAE?
Which specialist category do you believe fits you?
what_would_change_assessment: Confirmed category match and documents would increase readiness.
No UAE employment or required recommendation would block some categories.
A suspended or unavailable application channel would change next action.
opportunities.next_responsible_action: Run a category-by-category evidence checklist and verify the current application channel before presenting Golden Visa as a viable pathway.

demo_classification_hints.your_request_when: User asks about long-term residency, Golden Visa, specialist visa, or stability.
demo_classification_hints.other_possibility_when: User asks about work or education and reveals strong evidence that may support long-term residency.

guardrails: Do not claim eligibility without category-specific document evidence.
Do not provide immigration advice beyond evidence checklist and official-source routing.

opportunities.title: Real estate investor residency evidence check

best_fit_user_signals: Has capital for property investment
Wants long-term Abu Dhabi base for self or family
Needs residency implications checked alongside investment goals
circumstances_that_help: Investment budget and financing structure are clear
User understands property is an investment decision, not only a visa route
Can verify ownership, mortgage, and registration documentation
circumstances_that_block_or_slow: No confirmed budget or financing
Assumes residency without meeting property/document rules
No independent legal, tax, and property due diligence

transferable_capabilities.from_user_signal: Has savings, investment capital, or property-buying intent
transferable_capabilities.how_it_transfers: Can be evaluated against Abu Dhabi property-residency evidence requirements and investment-area rules

transferable_capabilities.from_user_signal: Wants a stable base, schools, housing, and long-term planning
transferable_capabilities.how_it_transfers: Can connect investment decision, residency possibility, and family logistics into one evidence chain

abu_dhabi_opportunity.description: Explore whether Abu Dhabi property ownership may support a Golden Visa or other property-linked residency route, subject to current rules and due diligence.

opportunities.why_this_matters_in_abu_dhabi: Property can be both a life-base and investment decision; MAI should expose the evidence and risks rather than treat property purchase as a simple residency shortcut.

evidence_refs.claim: ADRO describes real estate investor Golden Visa evidence requirements, including registered purchase or valuation evidence and a property value threshold referenced on the official page.
evidence_refs.source_name: Abu Dhabi Residents Office Golden Visa for Investors
evidence_refs.evidence_summary: Official ADRO source supports property-linked Golden Visa evidence checks.

evidence_refs.claim: ADRO notes Abu Dhabi has investment areas where foreign individuals and certain companies can own freehold interests, and connects property over AED 2 million with Golden Visa planning.
evidence_refs.source_name: Abu Dhabi Residents Office Where To Live
evidence_refs.evidence_summary: Official ADRO living guide supports context, but transaction rules require current legal/property verification.

missing_evidence: Current property value threshold and mortgage/off-plan treatment at time of application
Whether the target property is in an eligible ownership/investment area
Legal, tax, financing, service-charge, and resale-risk due diligence
gap_questions: What is your property budget and financing plan?
Are you buying to live, invest, rent out, or support residency planning?
Have you identified a specific property or investment area?
what_would_change_assessment: Confirmed property eligibility and valuation would reduce uncertainty.
Mortgage or off-plan structure may change evidence requirements.
Family schooling and commute needs may change property suitability.
opportunities.next_responsible_action: Verify property eligibility, ownership area, valuation, financing, and Golden Visa evidence with official channels and qualified advisors before making an offer.

demo_classification_hints.your_request_when: User asks about investment, property, or residency through real estate.
demo_classification_hints.other_possibility_when: User asks about family/new life and has significant investment capital.

guardrails: Do not give investment advice.
Do not claim a property purchase will secure residency without current official verification.

opportunities.title: Creative professional pathway through DCT Creative Visa or twofour54

best_fit_user_signals: Artist, designer, game developer, media professional, writer, performer, filmmaker, publisher, or creative entrepreneur
Has portfolio, public work, awards, clients, credits, or cultural contribution
Wants Abu Dhabi creative ecosystem rather than only generic employment
circumstances_that_help: Strong portfolio and evidence of creative work
Business model or freelance activity fits media/creative licensing
Can document recognition, clients, or contribution
circumstances_that_block_or_slow: No portfolio or public evidence
Creative work does not map to eligible categories
Visa, license, and income route are mixed up

transferable_capabilities.from_user_signal: Has published work, exhibitions, productions, game projects, design work, media credits, or awards
transferable_capabilities.how_it_transfers: Can support creative visa, licensing, freelance, or ecosystem exploration if category fit is verified

transferable_capabilities.from_user_signal: Can sell creative services or media products independently
transferable_capabilities.how_it_transfers: May map to twofour54 freelancer or company setup routes

abu_dhabi_opportunity.description: Explore whether the user fits Abu Dhabi creative residency, freelance, or media free zone setup routes.
relevant_entities: Department of Culture and Tourism - Abu Dhabi

opportunities.why_this_matters_in_abu_dhabi: Abu Dhabi has visible creative-industry institutions and licensing routes, allowing creative users to see futures beyond standard employment relocation.

evidence_refs.claim: DCT Abu Dhabi announced a Creative Visa initiative supporting talented individuals in cultural and creative industries including heritage, performing arts, visual arts, design, crafts, gaming, esports, media, and publishing.
evidence_refs.source_name: Department of Culture and Tourism Abu Dhabi Creative Visa announcement
evidence_refs.evidence_summary: Official DCT announcement supports the initiative, but current application requirements need verification.

evidence_refs.claim: twofour54 describes business setup and freelancer options in Abu Dhabi's media free zone, including support for media, gaming, production, and content creation businesses.
evidence_refs.evidence_summary: Official twofour54 source supports media free zone and freelancer setup exploration.

missing_evidence: Current Creative Visa application status and category requirements
Whether the user's portfolio fits DCT or twofour54 categories
Income, licensing, office, visa, and client requirements
gap_questions: What creative field are you in, and what portfolio evidence can you show?
Are you seeking employment, freelance licensing, company setup, or residency recognition?
Do you have clients, credits, awards, exhibitions, shipped games, published work, or media coverage?
what_would_change_assessment: A strong portfolio and category match would strengthen fit.
Current Creative Visa requirements may change route selection.
Need for immediate stable income may shift focus to employment or client pipeline first.
opportunities.next_responsible_action: Build a portfolio evidence checklist and verify whether DCT Creative Visa, twofour54 freelancer, or company setup is the most relevant official route.

demo_classification_hints.your_request_when: User asks about creative work, media, gaming, arts, or freelancing in Abu Dhabi.
demo_classification_hints.other_possibility_when: User asks for a new life and has a strong creative portfolio.

guardrails: Do not imply creative visa approval from talent alone.
Do not conflate residency recognition with business licensing.
